description: ETS Bus Schedule GTFS Data Feed - Trips is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. This dataset lists all trips and their routes in Edmonton. A trip is a sequence of two or more stops that occurs at specific time. For documentation please see. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Transit. Its tags are bus trip, transit, gtfs, ets. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
